subject: Short-term evidence upload + temporary access for OneTrust bridge
messages:
From: Jane Alvarez <jane@novumcloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@novumcloud.com
Date: 2026-08-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: OneTrust bridge — short-term evidence certification + temp access

Hi Irene,

Quick ask from our side as we prepare the vendor intake for Redwood: can you provide a short-term evidence package and a way for us to fetch artifacts via the OneTrust bridge? Our compliance team needs proof-of-possession for a handful of CAIQ items (TLS cert chains, SOC2 scoping docs, and a sample access log) and we'd like to avoid a full portal onboarding right now.

Ideal approach:
- a scoped manifest (CSV) that maps items to CAIQ/SIG questions
- a 48–72h presigned URL bundle or temporary credentials to pull the artifacts from S3
- a short statement certifying the evidence snapshot (what is included, extraction time window)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the presigned bundle or whether we should set up a OneTrust upload? We need to complete intake by EOD Wednesday (2026-08-12). If there are security constraints, please call them out and we can adjust timeline.

Thanks — appreciate it.

Jane Alvarez
Security Operations
NovumCloud

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust bridge — short-term evidence certification + temp access

Team — looping you in. NovumCloud is requesting a short-term evidence snapshot and either presigned URLs (48–72h) or an OneTrust upload. They need mapping to CAIQ/SIG and a POA (proof-of-possession) note. Target: EOD Wed (8/12).

Proposed plan (minimal blast):
- Ben: curate the scoped_evidence_manifest.csv (CAIQ mappings + file list) and a 1-paragraph evidence statement.
- Karthik: generate a presigned bundle (we can do an S3 presign manifest with individual object links) with TTL = 72h by default; confirm KMS key usage & audit logging.
- Mina: review the POA language and spot-check that none of the returns contain PII or disallowed customer content.
- Jonas: coordinate the OneTrust destination if we go that route (we'll prefer presign unless they insist).

Constraints to keep in mind:
- We cannot hand out long-lived keys; use STS/temporary credentials if we need programmatic access.
- All presigned links must be scoped to the minimum set of objects.
- We should produce an audit log snippet (redacted) showing object upload times and UUIDs to satisfy their request.

If everyone OK, I'll reply to Jane this morning with the chosen option and ETA (24 hours if we do presign).

Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust bridge — short-term evidence certification + temp access

Irene / all — I can generate the presigned URLs and prefer using short-lived STS-backed presigns rather than handing out temp creds. Notes and asks:

- TTL: 48h by default (I can do 72h if compliance prefers). Recommend 48h to reduce exposure.
- KMS: We'll use our existing evidence-bucket CMK; rotation is fine but does not block presigns. If NovumCloud needs a signed KMS assertion, that'll take longer to produce.
- Audit: I'll export the object-level CloudTrail events for the snapshot window and include a condensed CSV (redacted) we can attach as proof-of-possession.
- Format: I'll produce a presign_manifest.txt that lists each object paired with its CAIQ question id and the presigned URL.

Attachments: tempcred_rotation_plan.md (internal notes), presign_instructions.txt (how to consume the manifest).

I can have the manifest + presigned bundle ready within ~6 hours. Ben: please push the curated manifest to evidence-bucket/snapshots/novumcloud/20260810/ so I can presign. Mina: I'll share the audit snippet before we hand over.

—Karthik

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Alvarez <jane@novumcloud.com>
Cc: security@novumcloud.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: OneTrust bridge — short-term evidence certification + temp access

Hi Jane — thanks for the ask and the quick timeline. We can support the short-term approach. Plan and deliverables below: 

What you'll receive:
- scoped_evidence_manifest.csv (maps ~12 files to CAIQ/SIG questions) — attached in our internal handoff and uploaded to the snapshot folder.
- presign_manifest.txt (list of presigned URLs, each valid for 48 hours) — we'll send the manifest link in a follow-up email within the hour.
- condensed audit snippet (redacted CloudTrail events) as proof-of-possession.
- a short evidence statement: "Redwood Inference produced a time-bounded snapshot of artifacts enumerated in scoped_evidence_manifest.csv on 2026-08-10T09:00:00Z. The files were exported from our evidence repository and stored for presigned access. No customer PII was included."

Security controls and notes:
- Presigned URLs are STS-backed and TTL-limited to 48 hours.
- We will not provide long-lived credentials or CBK materials.
- KMS usage confirmed; we will include a KMS key-id reference in the audit snippet.

Next steps:
- Expect the presign_manifest.txt link in ~1 hour (we'll provide the OneTrust upload point if you prefer to ingest directly).
- If you'd rather we push into OneTrust on your behalf, let us know and we can coordinate access via Jonas.

Related links: OneTrust upload (if needed): https://onetrust.example.com/portal/novumcloud/upload-bridge — HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/RC-98765

If this meets your needs, we'll proceed.

Best,
Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
